videos.title: Count Down from 10 to 1 | Counting Backwards for Kids | Bo & Bloop
videos.description:
Bo & Bloop · Episode 7 · Count with Bo

Bo's Bubble Rocket is ready to fly... but one bolt is missing! Bloop the jellyfish finds it in the sand. Then Bo tries "One, two, three, go!" and "Ten, nine, seven..." and the rocket won't go. Count down from ten to one with Bo & Bloop, blast off, and sing the Countdown Song!

In this episode kids learn:
- Counting backwards from 10 to 1
- Each number is one less than the one before
- Don't skip a number: after nine comes eight!

00:00 Can you count backwards?
00:19 Bo's Bubble Rocket
00:24 The missing bolt
00:37 One, two, three... go?
00:52 Ten, nine, seven?
01:00 Count down with Bo!
01:16 Blast off!
01:27 One less each time
01:42 The Countdown Song
02:07 Bye-bye from Bubble Bay!

Next time: The Rainbow Coral

Bo & Bloop is a learning cartoon for kids aged 4-7, made in Bubble Bay. New episodes every week.
